name: Gorgonavis
isnote: Nebreda et al. (2026) consider it a likely longipterygid, a family otherwise known only from China.
sum: Barremian enantiornithean from Las Hoyas, Spain, known from a partial skull with a long snout.
holotype: MUPA-LH-13240, an isolated partial skull with snout, lower jaw and part of the braincase, Museo Paleontológico de Castilla-La Mancha.
biology: The skull is estimated at about 3 cm long; it is the first non-juvenile avialan skull from the Early Cretaceous of Europe.
author: Nebreda et al. 2026
